About

JOEL JOSEPH

"I believe great design should feel effortless — it simplifies complexity, solves real problems, and creates experiences people enjoy using."

As an aspiring UI/UX designer pursuing an Integrated MCA with internship experience, I focus on designing intuitive websites and mobile applications through research, user-centered thinking, and thoughtful visual design. I also bring designs to life through motion design, adding purposeful animation and micro-interactions to enhance the user experience. When I'm not designing, you'll find me exploring new design trends, refining my Figma skills, and building personal projects that challenge my creativity and strengthen my design process.

Feature · UI/UX Case Study
ECLIPSE — Sunglasses E-Commerce App

A modern luxury e-commerce mobile app for premium sunglasses, with AI-powered virtual try-on and a minimal dark-themed shopping experience.

Case Study — UI/UX Design
ECLIPSE — Premium Sunglasses E-Commerce App

A modern luxury e-commerce mobile application designed for premium sunglasses. The app focuses on delivering a smooth shopping experience with elegant visuals, intuitive navigation, AI-powered virtual try-on, secure checkout, and a minimal dark-themed interface.

My Role
UI/UX Designer — end-to-end: research, IA, user flow, wireframing, design system, UI, prototyping.
Tools Used
Figma (UI & Prototyping), FigJam (Flows & Planning), Adobe Photoshop (Mockups)
Deliverables
10+ mobile screens, design system, reusable components, interactive prototype
Features Designed
  • Luxury splash screen & home page
  • Product search, filters & listing
  • AI virtual try-on
  • Shopping cart & 3-step checkout (address, review, payment)
  • Order confirmation & user profile
Design Style
  • Minimal luxury interface, dark theme with gold accent
  • Premium typography, high contrast UI
  • Modern card components, smooth shopping journey

  • AI-powered virtual try-on to visualize frames before purchase

A modern LMS Admin Panel designed to help administrators manage users, courses, mentors, and learning analytics from a centralized dashboard.

Case Study — UI/UX Design
LMS Admin Panel — Learning Management System

A modern Learning Management System (LMS) Admin Panel designed to help administrators efficiently manage users, courses, mentors, and learning analytics from a centralized dashboard. The interface focuses on simplicity, scalability, and data-driven decision making.

My Role
UX research, IA, user flows, wireframing, high-fidelity UI, dashboard & data visualization, design system, interactive prototyping.
Tools Used
Figma, FigJam, Material Icons, Google Fonts, Auto Layout, Components & Variants
Deliverables
Full design system, admin/course/analytics modules, interactive prototype, responsive desktop design

Feature · UI/UX Case Study
Lumiora — Natural Skincare Website

A modern natural skincare e-commerce website for personalized skincare routines, with a clean, calming design and an intuitive shopping experience.

Case Study — UI/UX Design
Lumiora — Natural Skincare Website

A modern natural skincare e-commerce website designed for personalized skincare routines. The site pairs a calm, distraction-free shopping experience with clear product education — helping customers discover the right products, understand ingredients and benefits, and build a routine that fits their skin.

My Role
UI/UX Designer — end-to-end: user research, information architecture, user flows, wireframing, UI design, design system, prototyping, and responsive design.
Tools Used
Figma (UI & Prototyping), FigJam (Flows & Planning)
Deliverables
15+ web pages, design system, reusable components, responsive layouts, and interactive prototype.
Features Designed
  • Natural skincare-focused home page & product discovery
  • Product search, categories, filters & listing
  • Product details, ingredients & benefits
  • Skincare quiz & personalized routine
  • Wishlist, cart & coupon flow
  • Delivery details & streamlined checkout
  • Skincare blog & educational content
Design Style
  • Minimal, natural & calming interface with soft earthy tones
  • Elegant typography using Cormorant Garamond & Manrope
  • Clean layouts, organic visuals & subtle rounded cards
  • Soft green, cream & beige color palette
  • Intuitive navigation with a smooth, user-friendly shopping journey

  • Helped users understand ingredients, benefits, and suitable skincare routines
  • Added a personalized skincare quiz and routine experience
  • Streamlined the wishlist, cart, delivery, and checkout journey
  • Made product information and pricing easier to understand
  • Built a consistent and calming interface that improves trust and usability

In Brief — Software Dashboard
Campaign Control — Admin Dashboard

A clean admin dashboard to monitor companies and switch their campaigns on or off, with quick flows for creating campaigns and choosing which events to stop.

My Role
UI/UX Designer — dashboard layout, UI design and modal flows.
Platform
Web — admin software dashboard
Deliverables
5 screens: dashboard, expanded campaign view and 3 modals
What It Does
  • Overview cards for total companies and total anchors, with company search
  • Company cards with campaign count, on/off toggle and an expandable campaign table
  • Create New Campaign modal with type, name, Meta approved date and time
  • Turn-off flow: switch off all events or pick specific events with a last working day
Design Style
  • Light, uncluttered interface with soft white cards on a pale grey canvas
  • Dark navigation rail and a single amber accent for toggles and primary actions

In Brief — Software Dashboard
Anchor Hub — Video Folder Manager

A folder-based dashboard to organise anchor videos by production company, with quick search, starred folders and simple create flows.

My Role
UI/UX Designer — dashboard layout, UI design and modal flows.
Platform
Web — admin software dashboard
Deliverables
4 screens: Anchor Hub, anchor folders and 2 create modals
What It Does
  • Anchor Hub home with company and anchor totals, folder search and a Create action
  • Folder cards showing anchor count and video count, with star and menu options
  • Inside a folder: anchor cards with rate and video count, an Add Video action and an Onboard New Anchor tile
  • Simple modals to create a production company folder and a new anchor folder
Design Style
  • Familiar file-manager pattern with warm cream cards and amber folder icons
  • Consistent navigation, header and amber primary buttons shared with Campaign Control
